lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that Aaron's unclean descendants who approach the sacred offerings must be cut off from His presence.
A man who touches a crawling creature stays unclean until evening and must bathe before eating the sacred offerings.
Whoever eats a sacred offering in error must add a third to its value and give it to the priest.
An offering must be an unblemished male, and nothing blind, injured, or maimed goes on the altar.
A newborn ox, sheep, or goat must stay with its mother for ten days before it is acceptable.
